notes: More commonly used in its everyday uncontracted form πονάω (3rd person singular: πονάει). Simple past: πόνεσα.
Used both intransitively (to feel pain, or of a body part: to ache) and transitively (to hurt someone).

senses.definition: To feel physical pain, or (of a part of the body) to cause pain.
To feel emotional pain, sadness, or sympathy.
